==============
1. DESCRIPTION
==============

Detailed Ships revamps the interior and exterior of the purchasable ships. 

Outside, tight ropes are attached to the masts, crates and barrels are here and there, tenders sit on the top deck, rudders are present and there are additional railings. You may even spot a dolphin jumping out of the sea.

Inside, each room has a purpose. You'll find your personal quarters, the crew's quarters, kitchen, storage in the cargo hold, a shrine to Kynareth, goddess of the sailors, an armory and more. 
NPCs also hang around the decks, serving no other purpose than to be talked to and add some spice to your sea travels. If you prefer to sail alone, use the "No NPCs" version of Detailed Ships.

All interior containers can be used for safe storage. 

The large ship has one room I left empty on purpose so you can decorate it as you wish if you have the Decorator mod. 

Enjoy! Yar arr arr.

============================
2. INSTALLATION/REQUIREMENTS
============================

Detailed Ships requires Ninelan's Daggerfall Expanded Textures 1.2.0 or later found on the Daggerfall Unity Nexus : 
https://www.nexusmods.com/daggerfallunity/mods/307


Either install using Vortex Mod Manager or install manually as described below.


Extract the content of the archive to the StreamingAssets of your Daggerfall Unity directory.

Example : [Your drive]\DagUnity\DaggerfallUnity_Data\StreamingAssets

The .dfmod file will be installed in "Mods".

If you don't want NPCs, install Detailed Ships - No NPCs instead.

In-game, activate either of the Detailed Ships version you've choosen along with Daggerfall Expanded Textures from the mod launcher.

=================
3. UNINSTALLATION
=================

Simply remove the mod file from the "Mods" folder under StreamingAssets.

It is recommended you are not inside a city wall building when uninstalling.


=============
4. SAVE GAMES
=============

It is recommended you are not inside one of the ships when you first load the mod.


=========================
5. CONFLICTS/KNOWN ERRORS
=========================
Compatible with Decorator. Customize your ship even more by combining both mods. 

If you encounter any other issue with the mod, please let me know.


=========================
6. LEGAL STUFF/DISCLAIMER
=========================

The mod may be distributed/translated without my authorization as long as I am credited as the author. Spread the love!
